column2: Grace can be a stance of the one who sinned, not only something done to them.
The word grace can rightly name a creature's stance toward its own work.
Grace need not be given by another to be grace.
Facing one's own work is not a work that earns anything.
Facing oneself as a whole includes facing one's own works as far as they are understood.
Facing God's creation as God's work is something a person can do, not only receive.
